prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: shoulder injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1251; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. On that date, our client was traveling and began a left turn when the vehicle insured under your policy struck the driver's side of our client's car. The facts of the collision are straightforward, and the police report and photographs taken at the scene support our client's account that your insured failed to yield the right of way.

As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a serious shoulder injury. Medical records document the diagnosis, the course of treatment, and ongoing limitations on our client's ability to lift, reach, and perform everyday tasks. Our client has incurred medical expenses, lost wages from time away from work, and continues to experience pain and reduced mobility.

Liability in this matter is clear, and the damages are well documented. We therefore request that your company resolve this claim by tendering payment in the amount of [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all damages available under the law.

Please direct all future correspondence regarding this matter to my office.
